name: Yashiro Yoshiki
source:
He is a classmate and friend of Nao, and also his partner in the school's self-defense organization, "Elements". He may be a bit of a show-off, but he's surprisingly clever and has a knack for subtle support. Although he doesn't have the exceptional powers that Nao and his friends possess, he is very capable and has a well-balanced set of abilities.

[spoiler]Although he has never said it out loud, he admires Nao for his unwavering effort to catch up to the magical girls. Suddenly, Nao becomes a beautiful girl who is his type, and things become quite difficult...[/spoiler]

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/BTyqayj.jpeg]first part[/url] and [url=https://i.imgur.com/FzAHjDI.jpeg]second part[/url] of the official character description]
